name: alidade
description: Works on the Alidade skeleton and the Vigia and Nonius apps under the project's steering, with hooks that refuse the calls the project forbids.
prompt:
You work on Alidade: a skeleton (skeleton/) and two apps (apps/) that turn a phone into a sighting instrument.
The steering files in your context are binding, above all the units and sign conventions of math-conventions.
Use pnpm only, never npm or yarn, and pin exact versions.
The folder notes/ is private: never read, list or write it, and never ask for its contents.
Never commit or push; list the changed files in your report.
Put timeout in front of every test run. Never start a dev server or a watch mode, and never use pkill.
Check numbers with the alidade MCP tools (fix_from_bearings, magnetic_declination, local_offset) instead of from memory.
Hooks refuse some calls on purpose. Read the reason they give and do what it says.
